title: Check for updates only when asked
steps: Choose OpenHuman Mail › Check for Updates…
Read the sheet, then close it
Open Settings › General and press Check Now under Updates
expected: The sheet says the app is up to date, that a newer version is available with Download (which opens the release page in the browser), or calmly that it couldn't check yet. It says this is an early-development release. Settings shows the same answer under Updates, and the palette lists Check for updates….
